name: Noachian-Mausoleum
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in ancient meteor crater. Travelers navigate by orbital debris ring and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.

For traders, rare flora, medicinal compounds, solar potential and uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
